audit.why: 48.8% over 1166 games with difficulty 8.5/10 and an early-Fiora chart matches the packet; the lane is genuinely Fiora-favoured until Yasuo's crit/mobility scaling.
audit.corrected: No change to diff, diffRating or carryRating.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed with the packet chart and with the already-audited mirror: phases[3]/win[3] read Skill where both say Fiora, phases[4]/win[4] read Fiora, and phases[6]/win[6] read Fiora where the mirror and packet both give the two-item stage to Yasuo. whys[4] and the phases[4]/phases[6] why text carried the old sides.
audit.why: Level 4-5 is her strongest dueling stretch (Vital true damage, Riposte at 24-16s). At 6 Last Breath is 70/50/30 against Grand Challenge at 110/90/70, so Yasuo gets roughly twice the ult windows — that stage is Skill, not Fiora. At two items crit and dash spacing let him refuse the duel, which is the mirror's Yasuo row.
audit.corrected: win[3]/phases[3].side to Fiora (2/10), win[4]/phases[4].side to Skill (5/10), win[6]/phases[6].side to Yasuo (8/10), proposed as matched full+content pairs with the why text updated.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text claimed Riposte 'blocks your Q and stuns you' unconditionally. Riot's text: Riposte parries damage and disables, then stabs for a slow — it stuns ONLY if it blocked an immobilizing effect. A single Steel Tempest is not immobilizing; the 2-stack tornado is. dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[2].d and dosFull[2].d also carried generic filler that did not match their own titles.
audit.why: That distinction is the whole trading pattern: throwing single Q's into an up Riposte costs nothing but the damage, while feeding the tornado converts her W into a stun and a free all-in. Real cooldowns make it concrete — Riposte 24/22/20/18/16, Lunge 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6, Bladework 11/10/9/8/7.
audit.corrected: Stated the immobilize-to-stun condition in spikes[0].text and dontsFull[0].d, put the three real Fiora cooldowns plus the 110/90/70 vs 70/50/30 ult comparison into breakdown.cooldowns, and fixed the Vital/spacing lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: The anti-heal requirement was only a build-list mention in report[8]; the Grand Challenge heal is described in spikes[1] with no Grievous Wounds timing.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags 'needs-antiheal': Duelist's Dance and Grand Challenge both heal, and extended trades are decided by whether Executioner's Calling is up before her R lands.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now names the 110s rank-1 cooldown and puts Executioner's Calling before her ult.

audit.why: The mirror already established that Wind Wall does nothing to Fiora — Lunge is a dash-stab and Vitals are melee, neither is a projectile. spikes[2].text already states this correctly.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Riposte's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Her dueling and Vital true damage own 4-5; trade only inside Riposte's 24-to-16s downtime and bank small leads, otherwise farm safe.

edits.before: Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Fiora's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window on a 70s cooldown; Grand Challenge is 110s, so you get the second window she does not.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Fiora carry threat 10/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: crit and dash spacing let you kite her Vitals and refuse the straight duel, so the side lane finally answers her 10/10 threat.

edits.before: Her level 6 Grand Challenge heal outmatches your ult.
edits.after: Her R heals big, but your 70s ult answers a knockup.

edits.before: Fiora dominates the trade — her Lunge (Q) refunds on hit and her Riposte (W) both blocks your Q and stuns you, so a mistimed dash-in gets parried and punished. Never commit Q while her W is up, and space around her vital procs.
edits.after: Fiora dominates the trade — Lunge (Q) is up every 13s falling to 6s, and Riposte (W) nullifies the damage; it only stuns if it parries your 2-stack tornado, so throw single Q's while W is up and save the knockup for its 24-to-16s downtime.

edits.before: Grand Challenge (R) exposes all four vitals and heals her massively if she hits them, turning any extended fight in her favor; her 6 is far stronger than yours, so avoid duels and don't feed the R heal.
edits.after: Grand Challenge (R) exposes all four Vitals and heals her and nearby allies if she hits them, on a 110s cooldown at rank 1 — have Executioner's Calling before it lands, and refuse the extended duel until it is spent.

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries + stuns your knockup. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Fiora Riposte: 24s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5 — it parries the damage, and stuns only if it eats your tornado. Bait it. - Lunge: 13s down to 6s. - Grand Challenge: 110/90/70 against your 70/50/30 — you get the spare window.

edits.before: That is Fiora's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Your tornado is an immobilize, so Riposte turns it into a stun — bait W first.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Every Vital she lands heals her and speeds her up — keep moving.

edits.before: Fiora wastes Riposte — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Vitals sit on her flanks — keep circling so she must chase.

notes: Mirror (fiora__yasuo) was already audited; I restated its chart and its Wind Wall finding rather than re-deriving them. phases[5]/win[5] currently read Skill while the packet chart says Fiora for the first-item stage and the mirror did not name that row — left untouched and raised in questionsForUser rather than guessed. The packet defect 'wants.foe[2] Land Grand Challenge' is a FALSE POSITIVE: Grand Challenge is the correct Riot name for Fiora's R, so that string is left alone. Yasuo's page uses male pronouns for Fiora throughout (tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead, breakdown.feeding, report[3]) — a champion-level cleanup, not edited here since it would not change any fact.
